themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Far-right and right-wing parties across Europe and the Americas are intensifying anti-immigration rhetoric and policies, often framing migration as a national security crisis. This theme is evident in Spain, Italy, Norway, and the UK, where parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Fremskrittspartiet, and Reform UK are advocating for stricter border controls, deportations, and the suspension of international agreements like Schengen.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Clashes with Germany over NGO-assisted migration, suspends Schengen with Spain over Ceuta crisis.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Criticizes Conservative Party's immigration policies, demands stricter controls.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes banning foreign nationals from UK benefits, advocates for stricter immigration enforcement.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticizes Macron's immigration policies, pushes for stricter national controls.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration tightens immigration policies, including work requirements for Medicaid and stricter asylum rules.

themes.title: Far-right parties gain ground in regional and national elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are making significant electoral gains across Europe, particularly in Germany, Sweden, and Italy. These gains are often framed as a backlash against mainstream parties, with far-right leaders positioning themselves as the only viable alternative to the status quo. The theme is marked by intense campaigning, internal party conflicts, and rising poll numbers.

countries.note: Leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt, gains traction in national polls, faces internal divisions and legal challenges.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Proposes state-run psychiatric homes, debates nationalization of healthcare, faces internal policy disputes.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Faces internal leadership challenges, Salvini's leadership questioned amid declining poll numbers.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella's rising influence, party gains in polls ahead of 2027 elections.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Leads polls in Norway, faces internal debates over climate and energy policies.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right governments are increasingly targeting social programs, including welfare, healthcare, and education, as part of broader fiscal austerity measures. These policies are often justified as necessary to reduce public spending and debt, but they face significant backlash from opposition parties and civil society groups.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes cutting disability benefits, mandating community work for welfare recipients, and scrapping PIP.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government cuts social spending, privatizes state-owned enterprises, and faces protests from unions and civil society.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Debates welfare reforms, proposes tax cuts, and criticizes government spending on social programs.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Criticizes government's handling of state-owned enterprises, proposes reforms to social programs.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Tisza government reviews state contracts, cuts funding for social programs, and faces criticism over economic policies.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders face internal party divisions and leadership challenges

These conflicts often revolve around ideological differences, strategic direction, and personal rivalries, with factions pushing for leadership changes or even party splits.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox

themes.title: Trump administration targets gender-affirming care and LGBTQ+ rights
themes.blurb: The Trump administration and allied right-wing governments are intensifying efforts to restrict gender-affirming care and LGBTQ+ rights. These policies are framed as protecting traditional values and family structures, but they face strong opposition from human rights groups and progressive organizations.
